answer_1.quote: The task of image captioning is seemingly straightforward to define: use natural language to generate a description that captures the salient content of an image... we introduce a coherence‑aware caption generation model.
answer_1.outputs: Generated image captions conditioned on predicted or specified coherence relations

answer_2.quote: The CIDEr score of the captions generated by the coherence‑aware and the coherence‑agnostic models are, respectively, 0.958 and 0.964.

answer_4.quote: We asked our annotators to annotate a subset of randomly selected image‑caption pairs generated by this model... We ask subjects whether the generated captions are "good" or not... 86% of the captions generated by the coherence‑aware model were selected as "good" captions... we study the quality and the relevance of the captions... On a scale of 0 to 5, the average scores of the quality... and the relevance...
answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to judge if a caption is good, to rate its quality on a 0‑5 scale, to rate its relevance on a 0‑5 scale, and to assess whether the caption matches the intended coherence label (Visible, Story, Subjective, Meta, Irrelevant).
